title: Heritage Short storyboard
description: Single source of truth for the film. Every pipeline stage validates against this schema before it runs.

style_block.description: Appended to every image prompt. The code also appends fixed composition rules: subject centred (9:16 safe), no text in images.

cast.description: People by NAME -> visual description. A shot lists them in people[]; their NAMEs in its image_prompt are replaced by these descriptions (only in those shots). Describe positively: FLUX has no negative prompt.

reference_image.description: Approved reference sheet (repo-relative path), set by `python -m pipeline.keyframes --approve <id>=N`. null = not approved yet.

reference.description: false = no reference sheet for this character: its description is still added to prompts, but keyframes are not conditioned on an image.

voice.description: A preset Gemini TTS voice name. Never a cloned voice.

effect.description: Applied in assembly: 'downstairs' = low-pass + light reverb.

music_start_after_line.description: Optional line id (<shot>_<n>): the score starts just after this line ends (e.g. Mom's opening call plays over silence).

music_fade_in_s.description: Optional fade-in (seconds) of the score's first entrance, so it doesn't start hard after the hook. Default 0.5.

caption.description: Instruments, mood, texture. Tempo and key go in bpm/key, not here.

duration_s.description: Length of one generated section; assembly joins sections to fit the timeline.

start_s.description: Optional and ignored: the real span always comes from timeline.json (shots[].music_cue; the last cue also covers the end card).

ab_caption.description: A/B experiment: the last candidate uses this caption instead of caption.

clean_until_s.description: Assembly uses the selected section only up to this time (s): a damaged end (MusicGen's end-of-generation whistle) is dropped and each loop crossfades back before it. Not part of the music cache key.

ambience.description: Background beds (committed recordings) played under shots, inside the music bed so the narration ducks them too. Licences go in ETHICS.md.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the recording; it loops if shorter than its window.

shots.description: Shot ids: the bed plays from the first one's start to the last one's end.

level_db.description: Loudness relative to the music bed, before ducking (default -4).

lowpass_hz.description: Low-pass so no word is intelligible (default 2500).

fade_s.description: Fade in and out inside the window (default 1).

duration_s.description: Minimum length; the timeline extends it to fit narration + 0.5 s.

reason.description: Why this shot exists in the story.

characters.description: Characters visible in the shot (descriptions added to the prompt, approved reference sheets used for conditioning).

people.description: cast NAMEs in this shot; their descriptions replace the NAMEs in image_prompt.

reference_images.description: Extra conditioning images (repo-relative), e.g. an earlier keyframe whose composition should be kept.

keyframe_seed.description: Seed of the picked keyframe candidate (default: seed). Separate from seed, which narration and Wan keys use.

vertical_fill.description: 9:16 only, Wan clips: always use the blurred fill for this shot, also in the crop film (content off-centre).

vertical_x.description: 9:16 crop film only, Wan clips: horizontal position of the crop window (-1 left edge, 0 centre, 1 right edge).

music_gain_db.description: Lower the score under this shot (dB, after gain matching, before ducking); consecutive shots with the same value form one dip with 1 s ramps outside it.

text.description: The line as written (subtitles, reasons, notes).

style_note.description: Optional extra style for this line only, appended to the speaker's style_instruction (changes only this line's cache key).

tts_text.description: Optional spoken text sent to TTS, e.g. Amharic words in Ge'ez script inside the English sentence for correct pronunciation. Default: text.

subtitle_en.description: Optional subtitle override; default is the line text.

wan.description: Per-shot Wan settings over config/models.json wan (part of this shot's clip key only), e.g. smaller clips that fit the T4.
